Record Class NitriteRuntimeFilter

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.data.nitrite.model.query.builder.NitriteRuntimeFilter
Record Components:
filter - the filter map, keyed by field name (or the empty map for "match all")
sort - the sort keys, in order of precedence
projection - the projection map, keyed by field name to 1/true when included
offset - the offset, or 0 if unset
limit - the limit, or -1 if unset
parameterBindings - the parameter bindings referenced by the filter
@Internal public record NitriteRuntimeFilter(Map<String,Object> filter, List<NitriteSortKey> sort, Map<String,Object> projection, int offset, int limit, List<io.micronaut.data.model.query.builder.QueryParameterBinding> parameterBindings) extends Record
The result of NitriteQueryBuilder.buildRuntimeFilter(QueryBuilder.SelectQueryDefinition): the filter, sort and projection maps built directly from a runtime Criteria query, with no JSON serialize/reparse round trip. Values keep their original Java types (Integer, Long, BigDecimal, ...) exactly as produced by NitritePredicateVisitor — nothing is lost or narrowed the way it would be if the filter had to survive a text round trip.
Since:
5.2.0

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
